column1: # French wordlist. Levels are frequency bands under a hand-written A1/A2 core, not CEFR judgments: lemmas ranked by the geometric mean of their subtitle frequency in Lexique 3.83 (New, Pallier et al., lexique.org, CC BY-SA 4.0) and Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR). Built by scripts/build-fr-wordlist.py.
